title: Gotham Taekwon-do

services.name: Juniors Program
services.desc: Juniors (Ages 8 - 12) is a traditional Taekwon-do program for children. Students will develop a strong foundation in martial arts. Classes run in a similar format to the Adults program, modified to be more applicable for the age group. Students are expected to show leadership and become role models to the younger students as they assist the Little Heroes and Martial Mind classes. Our Juniors curriculum focuses on improving both their mind and body through traditional Taekwon-do training. To achieve this, we put a strong emphasis on the tenets of Taekwon-do: Courtesy, Integrity, Perseverance, Self-control, and Indomitable Spirit (further explained below) throughout our classes.
